'''Goh's Grimer''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのベトベター''' ''Go's Betbeter'') is the twenty-third {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Kanto]] [[region]], and his thirty-sixth overall.

==History==
==={{aniseries|JN}}===
[[File:Goh Grimer Froakie.png|thumb|left|250px|Grimer and Froakie]]
[[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} {{p|Grimer}} in ''[[JN020|Dreams Are Made of These!]]'' while he was participating in a [[Pokémon Orienteering]] competition.

In ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', when [[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]] was experiencing an unexplained food shortage, Grimer was one of the Pokémon affected by the hunger and driven into fighting the other Pokémon. When [[Goh's Golurk]] went out of control due to the seal on its chest being removed, Grimer helped protect the {{p|Cascoon}} from the flood caused by Golurk's rampage, allowing them to evolve into {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Dustox}}.

In ''[[JN107|Big Brother to the Rescue!]]'', Grimer caused Cerise Park's water stream to be polluted by bathing in its water source, as it had given its previous cave home for {{TP|Goh|Froakie}} to inhabit. As such, Goh, decided to help build Grimer a new home in the form of a pond that it could bathe in without polluting the stream. The pond was quickly completed, with {{TP|Goh|Suicune}} helping to clean up the polluted stream afterwards.

In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Grimer attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure.

==Personality and characteristics==
Grimer is a friendly Pokémon who doesn't intend to cause harm to anyone, but can end up inadvertently causing problem to others around it, as seen by it polluting [[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]]'s water stream without meaning to. It also was considerate enough to offer its old home to a newcomer, having made friends with {{TP|Goh|Froakie}} soon after its arrival in Cerise Park.
